description: This file defines an Android Java activity class named 'Arcs' which extends GraphicsActivity. It contains a nested 'SampleView' class that extends View and implements custom drawing of arcs and ovals on a Canvas. The code demonstrates usage of the Android graphics API, particularly drawing arcs with different styles and configurations.

classes.name: Arcs
classes.description: An Android activity class that sets up a custom view to draw animated arcs demonstrating different paint styles and configurations.

classes.name: SampleView
classes.description: A custom View subclass that draws multiple arcs with varying styles and properties to demonstrate Android graphics API usage.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Overrides the activity lifecycle method to set the content view to a new instance of SampleView.

methods.name: drawArcs
methods.description: A private helper method that draws an arc and its bounding rectangle on the canvas, with specified style and paint.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Overrides the View's onDraw method to render arcs with animated sweep and start angles, updating state for animation.

methods.name: SampleView constructor
methods.description: Initializes paints, rectangles, and other drawing parameters for the custom view.
